mapper.sql: u.id, u.nickname, u.handle, u.avatar_hue, u.city, u.role, u.bio, u.verified, u.followers_count, u.following_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_follow f WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = u.id) AS followed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track t WHERE t.artist_id = u.id) AS track_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM thread th WHERE th.author_id = u.id) AS thread_count
